issue.title: Drop Python stale-binding artifact-relation fallbacks once the sase-core-rs floor includes awaits
issue.description: Remove the Python stale-binding relation fallbacks added by sase-17o.2 once the published sase-core-rs floor (pyproject / tools/probe_core_floor declared floor, currently 0.34.71) includes the `awaits` relation from sase-core eef7ca4: `lookup_artifact_relation_with_fallback` and `artifact_relation_label_with_fallback` in src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_store_support.py (and their try/except call sites in src/sase/ace/tui/relations/link_index.py `_build_chip`, src/sase/sdd/artifact_link_neighborhood.py `_labeled_neighbors`, src/sase/artifact_cli/link_ops.py, src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_store_rows.py, src/sase/sdd/artifact_link_inlet.py), plus the `awaits` entry in `_PROJECTION_RELATIONS` if the other projection entries are retired at the same time. Callers should go back to `require_rust_binding("artifact_relation_lookup")` / `artifact_relation_label` directly. Blocked on a sase-core release tag containing eef7ca4 and a floor raise. Proposed by phase bead sase-17o.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2).

Callers should go back to `require_rust_binding("artifact_relation_lookup")` / `artifact_relation_label` directly. Blocked on a sase-core release tag containing eef7ca4 and a floor raise. Proposed by phase bead sase-17o.2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The fallbacks are required now: the installed sase-core-rs wheel (0.34.71 floor) predates eef7ca4, so dropping them inside sase-17o would break relation lookup for `awaits` rows on every stale binding. The removal can only happen after a sase-core release and floor raise, which is outside the epic.
